scientific_boundary: This snapshot records that the eleventh bounded trigger search found no typed public P1553 target-local remainder transducer for r_R mod g_I and no exact dyadic subinterval unit-product interface, over a scope of algebraic coding theory and sparse-interpolation literature (Reed-Solomon/BCH syndrome decoding, error-locator polynomial constructions -- Berlekamp-Massey, Euclidean-algorithm/Sugiyama decoder, Peterson-Gorenstein-Zierler -- and sparse polynomial/exponential-sum reconstruction -- Ben-Or/Tiwari, Prony's method) explicitly disjoint from rounds seven through ten. Two independent, checkable negative findings are credited, each narrow to the exact formulations read: (1) every retrieved syndrome/error-locator construction defines its 'syndrome' as a function of an already-received, witness-bearing (corrupted) word, and the direction these decoders make cheap (public syndrome to unknown locator roots) is the reverse of the direction P1553 needs; the matching direction, per a CRT-bijection argument the coordinator scrutinized and flagged as conditional on g_I's squarefree-splitting premise (from H-CREP-001, not independently re-derived), collapses exactly to the already-costed ROUTE-04 (multipoint evaluation) rather than supplying a new identity; (2) sparse-interpolation/Prony reconstruction (Ben-Or/Tiwari) separately requires an a priori sparsity bound and a free evaluation oracle, neither established for r_R in the frozen setting. Candidates C1-C5 each carry G1 present but fail G2, G3, and G8; C4 (Wiedemann/Block-Wiedemann) and C5 (LFSR annihilator attacks) are off-target. Neither finding establishes a general impossibility for coding-theoretic or sparse-interpolation techniques beyond the exact formulations searched, creates or consumes a B71 or batch slot (maximum_batches is null per DEC-20260828-f65ce9), or claims any attack, speedup, cryptographic-scale result, novelty, closure, support, scientific transition, goal transition, or breakthrough. Pollard rho remains the realized frontier and every other explicitly untested route remains open. No ledger/decisions/DEC-*.yaml, ledger/evidence/EV-*.yaml, or knowledge/findings/KN-FIND-*.md record is created by this task, consistent with rounds seven through ten's precedent of recording non-batch pre-admission closures solely in the goal head. The Coordinator opened round twelve on a scope explicitly disjoint from rounds seven through eleven: eigenvalue and structured-matrix methods for resultant/remainder computation (Bezoutian-matrix eigenstructure, companion-matrix/Sylvester-matrix pencils, u-resultants, multiplication-operator eigenvalue methods -- Stetter-Moller / Auzinger-Stetter matrices), with an explicit G8 pointer to the already-costed ROUTE-08 (displacement representation) given its shared lineage with structured-matrix methods.
